title: CI is red on main
summary: The agent-workboard CI workflow has three independently failing jobs on the main branch, preventing a clean tracker-adoption delivery.
expected: The CI workflow passes its Rust, fuzz, and Windows release jobs on main and on configuration-only pull requests.
actual: Main run 36435467943 and adoption PR run 39128794278 fail rust tests without a Git identity, fuzz because cargo-fuzz runs stable rustc, and the Windows release test because multiple Git executable paths are treated as one command.
evidence: Both runs fail all three job names. The adoption branch changes only tracker configuration; the main run at its exact base commit already has the same failing jobs.
impact: CI cannot establish a green delivery state for unrelated configuration changes.
resolution: A dedicated CI repair makes the three jobs pass on a fresh GitHub Actions run and leaves the tracker-adoption PR with passing required checks.
cause: Confirmed workflow and release-test configuration defects: no test Git identity, stable toolchain overriding nightly fuzz instrumentation, and an unselected multi-result Git command lookup.
repair: PR #3 repaired CI and Windows installer/updater behavior, merged as 2bca92e7ecde351202e3e2d468082e9fbf453d84.
next_action: Continue the remaining eligible personal-repository tracker rollout.
verification: Repair run 39135954035 and the rebased adoption run 39136652023 each passed rust, fuzz, and windows-release; GitHub bug #2 is closed.
